answer: Price new identities by the tide. The registration fee doubles for every 50 sign-ups above the 30-epoch average, then decays back. A newcomer on a quiet day pays the 10 POA base. A farmer pushing 500 keys in one pulse climbs a fee ridge: estimate, assuming a 10 POA base, key 51 costs 20, key 101 costs 40, key 500 costs 5,120, so the batch tops 500,000 POA. Trickling clones in slowly just lets honest growth outpace them. Tradeoff: a real hype wave of newcomers pays surge prices too.
